violated_contract: An access token is valid only for the OAuth scopes it was minted with. Code that borrows one client's token to call a different Google API (for example the storage client's devstorage-scoped token handed to IAM signBlob) must mint a token scoped for that API; on Cloud Run the metadata server honours the requested scopes, so the borrowed token fails ACCESS_TOKEN_SCOPE_INSUFFICIENT, while a JSON key or GKE Workload Identity hides the defect.
canonical_prevention: Derive a separately scoped credential of the same identity (with_scopes(cloud-platform)) for every cross-API call, cache it, and cover it with a test whose fake credentials mint tokens that carry only the requested scopes; prove the path on a real Cloud Run runtime before the key fallback is removed.
